observations: First Settings launch showed a blank view and the process later disappeared. A fresh private stackshot confirmed another scene-create watchdog termination.
Clock PID 230 rendered world clocks, switched to Stopwatch and accepted Start. A subsequent frame showed a running count beyond 21 seconds; the process remained present in the later probe.
Notes rendered its welcome sheet, accepted Continue and displayed the folders view with an iCloud prompt. Full note editing and later process survival are not confirmed.

A subsequent Settings launch rendered the menu. Later frames showed Accessibility and AssistiveTouch settings; Preferences PID 311 remained present in the final probe. The specific navigation target did not match every injected input, so exact touch mapping needs separate verification.

limitations: Successful launches after warm-up do not establish that the service change alone caused the improvement.
Cold-launch reliability, repeated launch/exit cycles and all applications remain unverified.
The older phone VM archive and IPA do not contain this guest configuration change.
No new production IPA or VM bundle is designated ready.
